answer.explanation: The live configuration of the Thumbnailer function is MemorySize 128 MB and Timeout 3 s, last modified at 01:38:22Z. The committed template.yaml declares 1024 MB and 30 s, and no recent commit touches these values, so the change was made outside the IaC. Logs confirm the effect: before the window, invocations ran at Memory Size 1024 MB with about 100 ms duration. From 01:38 onward they run at 128 MB with average duration about 430 ms and peaks of about 800 ms (2.2 s in the first bin). The shrunken memory slowed execution roughly 4x, and the 3 s timeout is now close to the observed peaks. No IAM, code or environment-variable anomaly was found on the Thumbnailer, and the CrudApi TABLE_NAME commit 24f3656 was already reverted by ca30e64 with the live value correct.
